# Single Source of Structural OKF Rules

This file acts as the authoritative location for structural rules governing OKF file conformance, specifically enforcing reserved filenames' frontmatter constraints and required fields for concept pages. Both the validator and renderer consult these rules to stay in sync and reduce the risk of divergence. By co-locating these rules, changes need to be made only once and will propagate to all consumers.
